behaviors_asserted: CSRF middleware blocks formData (multipart/form-data) POST requests even when the Origin is in the allowed origin list.
Including both 'Origin' and 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' headers in the request causes the CSRF middleware to respond with 403.
Removing the explicit 'Content-Type' header and setting the 'Origin' header allows the request to pass CSRF middleware and return 200.
Requests from web browsers succeed without explicit Content-Type/Origin headers, while formData requests from iOS/Android apps are blocked by the CSRF middleware.
